definitions.explanation: Not special or different from what is expected.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦したい→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I want to live a normal life.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧⟦ですか→です：09485_desu⟧。
{普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧ので、⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: I took the local train, so it took a long time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{普通|ふつう}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}った→思う：00492_omou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{美味|おい}しい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}った→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: I thought this dish was ordinary, but my friend said it was very delicious.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。

examples.english: I usually wake up at 7 a.m.

examples.japanese: {普通|ふつう}、⟦{日曜日|にちようび}→日曜日：00656_nichiyoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I usually rest at home on Sundays.
This store is usually open until 10 p.m.
I usually commute by train, but on rainy days I sometimes drive.

notes:
{普通|ふつう} means ordinary, normal, or usually. It's highly versatile, functioning as a noun, な-adjective, and adverb.

AS AN ADJECTIVE:
- {普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: ordinary person
- {普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧: normal life
- {普通|ふつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: normal size

AS AN ADVERB:
- {普通|ふつう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧～: usually ~
- {普通|ふつう}、7⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧: I usually wake up at 7

TRAIN TERMINOLOGY:
{普通|ふつう}⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧ (local train) stops at every station, unlike ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧ (express) or ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (limited express).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{通常|つうじょう}→通常：27316_tsuujou⟧: usually, normally (more formal)
- ⟦{一般的|いっぱんてき}→一般的：04784_ippanteki⟧: general, typical
- ⟦{平凡|へいぼん}→平凡：12425_heibon⟧: ordinary, mediocre
